recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-34380. Future movement of service-mode terminology to THO should be handled by the later THO-migration work such as FHIR-55297, not by reopening this R5 PractitionerRole reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification PA request to add a PractitionerRole attribute for practitioner modes of service delivery, add a matching search parameter, add example service-mode terminology, bind PractitionerRole.characteristic to that terminology, and update HealthcareService.characteristic example terminology in the same area.
initial_application: Git commit 674ac4c30338106ba2fc79fb3203bcb7e535ad03 applied the issue by adding PractitionerRole.characteristic, the PractitionerRole characteristic SearchParameter, the service-mode CodeSystem and ValueSet, and the HealthcareService.characteristic example binding to the service-mode ValueSet.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has active PractitionerRole and HealthcareService resource entries, so the inspected resource folders are in current build scope. Later Applied issue FHIR-39306 records that an example value set for HealthcareService.characteristics had already been added, and later Applied issue FHIR-53269 intentionally sets the service-mode CodeSystem/ValueSet experimental flag to false. FHIR-55297 is a later Resolved - change required proposal to move the HealthcareService service-mode binding to THO, but it is not Applied/Published and was treated only as background in this default run.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with no source changes because the current source already conveys the approved PractitionerRole service-mode capability and later PA decisions support retaining the current service-mode binding rather than making a new FHIR-34380 correction.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied PA issue says HealthcareService.characteristics already had an example value set, supporting no extra FHIR-34380 source change.
Later Applied PA issue updates service-mode metadata to experimental=false, confirming service-mode remains intentional current-core terminology.
Later Resolved - change required issue proposes moving the HealthcareService service-mode binding to THO, but it is not Applied/Published and is outside this seed decision.
